# index.html — section map

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/gen-map.mjs — DO NOT EDIT BY HAND.
     Regenerate with:  node scripts/gen-map.mjs

`index.html` is one self-contained file that has to boot from `file://`, so it can never be split into modules.
Its banner comments are the navigation. **Jump by searching for the anchor text**, not by line number:

```
grep -n "---------- glsl lenses:" index.html
```

Zones, in file order:

- **Head** — before `<style>` — meta, icons and the two pre-paint scripts
- **CSS** — inside `<style>` — every rule the studio ships
- **Markup** — inside `<body>` — the stage and the control panel
- **JavaScript** — inside the closing `<script>` — one IIFE, data first and boot last
- **GLSL** — inside `var FSRC = [ … ]` — the fragment shader, as an array of source lines
